summary: Military aircraft high energy manoeuvres within 5 nautical miles of Glaisdale, up to 20000 ft above sea level.
text:
3 MIL ACFT WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEUVRES IN SUPPORT OF EXER 
WI 5NM RADIUS OF 542625N 0005101W (GLAISDALE). ACFT MAY OPR AT 
SPEEDS UP TO 450KT IAS AND MAY BE UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. AIC 
Y007/2023 REFERS. OPS CTC ON CH127.185 OR 277.350MHZ FOR INFO 07517 
258611. 
AR-2026-10148/03.
